title: Edgar Cayce Foundation funded Zahi Hawass

tellings.quote:
So the Edka Casey Foundation
funded Zahawas.

plain: The foundation set up around Edgar Cayce, an American psychic, paid for the work of Zahi Hawass, the Egyptian archaeologist who went on to oversee Egypt's ancient sites. A guest named Jay Anderson tells Michels this without naming a source, placing it between 1980 and 1993. If true, it would tie Egypt's top official archaeology to a group devoted to a psychic's visions.
